note: Overlay a same-session IEX/Alpaca mark onto `watchlist_trigger_alerts` when `prices_meta.price_as_of` is the prior daily bar, so a 12:00 ET Monday slot does not have to WebSearch to confirm that the written “Monday open at/under $497 that holds $491.10” condition actually printed.

Stamp the open-probe ticker and remaining probe slots on the slim pack (`ANET` occupies the only 0.50–0.59 seat) so a 14:00 cycle does not re-underwrite a 0.60+ Microsoft ticket that the noon desk already haircut to 0.56 and the validator then killed as `probe_cap_reached`; overlay `options_signals.spot` onto `watchlist_trigger_alerts` when `prices_meta.price_as_of` is Friday’s bar so this slot does not have to WebSearch to see that MSFT is $497.88 live versus a $493.78 Friday close.
